domain-information: A client requests a new proposal for advertising campaign that promotes a new product.
A client reviews the initial campaign proposal shared by the marketing manager.
A client provides feedback on the campaign visuals before final approval.
A client receives a layout draft from a graphic designer.
A marketing manager outlines the campaign objectives and defines the target audience.
A marketing manager assigns specific campaign tasks to the content creator and graphic designer.
A marketing manager reviews promotional copies created by content creators.
A marketing manager reviews performance reports to measure campaign results.
A marketing manager reviews trend reports to adjust the campaign accordingly.
A content creator writes promotional copy tailored to the campaign’s audience.
A content creator collaborates with the graphic designer to align visuals with the campaign message.
A content creator revises the copy based on feedback from the marketing manager.
A graphic designer creates layout drafts following the promotional copy.
A graphic designer adjusts draft after receiving client feedback.
A graphic designer delivers final design files to the marketing manager for submission.
A market analyst researches customer behavior.
A market analyst accesses market databases to prepare a trend report that informs the campaign strategy.
A market analyst evaluates engagement metrics after the campaign launch to report on its success.
A market analyst sends performance reports to the marketing manager.

domain objects.name: Client
domain objects.description: An organization or individual who commissions an advertising campaign.

domain objects.name: Advertising Campaign
domain objects.description: A coordinated marketing effort promoting a specific product or service.

domain objects.name: Product
domain objects.description: The item or service being promoted in the campaign.

domain objects.name: Campaign Objectives
domain objects.description: The specific goals and outcomes the campaign aims to achieve.

domain objects.name: Target Audience
domain objects.description: The group of people the campaign is intended to reach.

domain objects.name: Engagement Metrics
domain objects.description: Quantitative measures of campaign performance such as clicks or impressions.

domain objects.name: Final Design
domain objects.description: The approved visual materials ready for campaign publication.

domain objects.name: Campaign Proposal
domain objects.description: A preliminary plan that outlines the campaign’s strategy and creative direction.

domain objects.name: Client Feedback
domain objects.description: Responses and comments from the client regarding creative materials or proposals.

domain objects.name: Marketing Manager
domain objects.description: The person overseeing campaign planning, coordination, and delivery.

domain objects.name: Content Creator
domain objects.description: A specialist who writes promotional copy and aligns it with the campaign message.

domain objects.name: Graphic Designer
domain objects.description: A creative professional responsible for visual elements and layout design.

domain objects.name: Performance Report
domain objects.description: A summary of engagement results and effectiveness after campaign launch.

domain objects.name: Promotional Copy
domain objects.description: Text or written content created to convey the campaign’s message.

domain objects.name: Feedback
domain objects.description: Internal feedback from managers to creative staff for revision and improvement.

domain objects.name: Layout Draft
domain objects.description: A preliminary design version shared for client review and approval.

domain objects.name: Market Analyst
domain objects.description: A researcher who studies market trends, customer behavior, and campaign results.

domain objects.name: Trend Report
domain objects.description: An analysis of market patterns that informs campaign strategy.

domain objects.name: Market Database
domain objects.description: A collection of market and consumer data used for research and analysis.

associations.description: Client requests and reviews the Campaign Proposal.
Marketing Manager prepares and shares the Campaign Proposal.
Marketing Manager oversees execution of the Advertising Campaign.
Marketing Manager provides internal feedback to team members.
Content Creator receives feedback for copy revisions.
Graphic Designer produces the Final Design deliverables.
Marketing Manager receives and approves the Final Design.
Content Creator produces Promotional Copy for the campaign.
Marketing Manager reviews Promotional Copy for approval.
Content Creator collaborates with Graphic Designer to align visuals and message.
Graphic Designer creates the Layout Draft for client review.
Client reviews and comments on the Layout Draft.
Content Creator contributes written materials to the Advertising Campaign.
Graphic Designer contributes visuals to the Advertising Campaign.
Client provides Client Feedback on creative materials.
Graphic Designer receives Client Feedback for revisions.
Market Analyst studies the Client’s market and audience.
Market Analyst tracks and evaluates Engagement Metrics.
Market Analyst uses Market Database for research.
Market Analyst compiles Performance Reports from campaign data.
Market Analyst prepares Trend Reports based on research findings.
Marketing Manager reviews the Performance Report to assess results.
Marketing Manager uses the Trend Report to refine campaign strategy.
